golive.text: Add the clinic's real departments and positions, then run Tidy once (Tab 6).

Give the HR team their controls and department limits; give line managers Approve leave (Tab 6). Only a permissions administrator can give Confidential staff documents, Read appraisals and Grant HR permissions.
Review the four starter presets: they now include the newer controls (Tab 6).
Check the 2026 leave policy and publish it; review any entitlements set before the policy (Tab 3).
Check next year's (2027) public holidays, and add Idd-ul-Fitr once it is gazetted (Tab 3).
Decide the carry cap for Annual leave and set it before 31 December. Every type starts at 0, so nothing carries over until you do (Tab 3).
Set Reports to on every staff file (Employment card), so leave pre-adds each person's line manager as an approver and new appraisals default to them as reviewer (Tabs 4 and 8).
Set CPD targets, expiry reminder days and the team-calendar visible types (Tab 9).
Agree a clinic grace for check-ins and set it in Settings → Rules (Tab 5).
Add the shift types, then build and publish the first roster week (Tab 7).
Review the appraisal competencies; open the year when ready (Tab 8).
Tell staff about My leave, My profile, CPD, the Team calendar and My shifts (Tab 2).
Upload one staff document to confirm uploads work (Tab 4).

day1.text: Read 1. Start here and the Glossary.
Sign in; use the portal button to open the HR Suite. Click your own name to open My profile.
Remember your phone at the entrance tag and check in.
Open Dashboard: who is in, who is not yet in, what needs attention.
Open Time & Attendance, choose This week, and download the CSV once.
Open Staff, search for three colleagues, and open each file. Look at every tab.

day2.text: Resolve every missed check-out on the Dashboard (Tab 5).
Review any refused tap; record a manual entry only if the person was there.
Open Settings: read the Rules and the clinic-wide hours. Do not change them yet.
Find two part-time staff and check their working hours.
Note every "Not yet in" that is really a day off, and fix their hours.

day3.text: Open Leave settings → Leave policy and check this year says published.
Check Public holidays for this year; add any gazetted holiday that is missing.
Open Leave to approve → All and read through this year's leave.
Record one paper leave form for a colleague, with the HR manager watching.
Open Team calendar and compare it with what you know of next week.
Check every line manager holds Approve leave, and every staff file has Reports to set.

day4.text: Open Departments & positions. Is every file linked? Run Tidy if not (with the HR manager).
Open Onboarding: look at each checklist in progress and tick what you can confirm.
Open Profile requests and decide the waiting requests and CPD, checking each copy or certificate.
Upload one document to a staff file, with the right category and expiry date.
Open Reports → Licences and documents expiring. Contact anyone expiring within 30 days.

day5.text: Open Roster, choose a department, and read next week's draft and its warnings.
With the nurse in charge, adjust and publish one week.
Open Appraisals: check which step everyone is at and whether every reviewer is chosen.
Open Reports and download the headcount and punctuality reports.
Go through 10. Troubleshooting index and mark anything you have already met.
Agree with the HR manager which controls you keep, and which jobs stay with them.
